lessons.trigger_condition: The existing V373 meta neural network was trained from verified outcomes and influenced safe-learning actions, while V400 screen composition still used fixed evidence weights. V400 also stored surface history without the applied top-feature plan, so later verified surface improvements or regressions could not weakly tune the next screen decision.
lessons.prevention_rule: Feed only active, sufficiently trained V373 verified-outcome meta-neural scores into a tightly bounded advisory bias for the existing 18 allowlisted tablet features. Persist only the applied top-five features and verified surface scores in V400 history, derive a weak next-cycle correlation signal from later score changes, combine both signals under a strict total bias cap, and never collect user clicks or claim causal performance.
validation_required: watched runtime changes are exactly tablet_autonomous_evolution_v400.py and tablet_autonomy_dashboard_v400.js
meta neural UI bias is inactive below the verified-outcome minimum sample gate
meta neural UI bias maps only existing V373 META_ACTIONS to the exact 18 allowlisted feature keys
neural per-feature bias is capped at 0.06 and combined neural plus outcome bias is capped at 0.08
verified outcome feedback uses only previously applied plans and later verified surface scores
outcome feedback does not track clicks, pointer movement, browsing behavior or other user behavior
outcome feedback explicitly does not claim causality and is next-cycle advisory only
screen target allowlist, user restore, market non-directional boundary and protected-PR source boundary remain unchanged
source code generation, source rewrite, arbitrary commands, Git/main writes, verification bypass and TCG fact invention remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V400 sync connects the existing verified-outcome meta neural policy to tablet screen selection as a small advisory signal and adds weak verified surface-result feedback. It cannot train from unverified facts or user behavior, exceed bounded feature bias, create arbitrary UI or source code, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main, infer market direction, or fabricate price, grade, stock, release or event facts.
